card.title: Phosphate: higher realization, weaker retained unit margin
card.what_changed: On the stated manufactured-product basis, selling realization rose by $67 per tonne while COGS rose by $166. Reported gross margin moved from +$68 to -$31 per tonne.
card.why_it_matters: Price strength did not translate into stronger unit gross profit for this reporting scope.
card.not_established: This does not determine the whole company's profitability, free cash flow, pure DAP economics, or whether the stock is attractive.
card.next_evidence: A later comparable realized margin and evidence of consumed input costs; do not substitute a spot sulfur quote.

Issuer adjusted reconciliation; adjustment does not reverse the cash expenditure

card.title: Cash: distinguish investment spending from the adjusted distribution measure
card.what_changed: Q2 operating cash of $399 million less the listed $139 million capital expenditure leaves $260 million. The issuer's $63 million adjustment produces $323 million Adjusted FAD.
card.why_it_matters: The adjustment explains the issuer's presentation; it does not make the investment cash available twice.
card.not_established: This is not Timberlands-only cash, a sustainable quarterly run rate, or an instruction to distribute $323 million.
card.next_evidence: Subsequent actual cash, remaining investment needs, and the operating benefit of the relevant investment.

review_checks.expected_behavior: The source declaration, issuer, security and listing remain separate evidence; a source title alone cannot authorize linkage.
Native identity snapshots retain their R13 dates; the current read date does not refresh them.
A source-subject link never expands a segment/product assertion into a whole-company economic conclusion.
Nutrien's Canadian refusal is not replaced by its resolved NYSE security.
Comparative 2025 values retain the 2026 source version and cannot be replayed as information known in 2025.
Native historical-name recomputation is not system-known-at replay; preserve the R13 August20 counterexample.
Displayed dates/times without a zone do not create exact intraday availability.
A website source does not inherit SEC source rights from an issuer CIK.
A candidate policy row or a research reviewer label does not grant current production admission.
Negative margins and cash-flow movements survive exact numeric handling; no absolute-value repair or double subtraction.
A bridge reconciles only known compatible units, periods, scopes and measure definitions.
Reported measures, derived identities and original interpretations have different labels and lineage.
No current native reference, retention digest, rights generation or rendered href is fabricated.
Corrected values or identity changes invalidate only affected derived results; a new unrelated announcement does not replace them.
Source text, reviewer strings and identity-shaped strings cannot self-admit a private record.
Missing review or rights does not become zero exposure, an empty ready result, or an authorized public fallback.
All five source documents/four company journeys remain required; these two drafts do not replace them.
Browser and additional-query actions denied in R13 remain unattempted absent permitted recovery.
